verdict.rationale: Letta Code and the CLI support natural-language slash commands (/remember, /fork, /btw, /pin, /agents, /doctor) and conversational memory teaching, plus headless mode for scripted natural-language-driven tasks, showing an AI-native command interface throughout. missing for 10: independent/hands-on verification of the full breadth of natural-language command coverage beyond docs and a couple of forum confirmations (e.g., /yolo, /init).
